content.comment_body: Hello, I am using the Excel [product_name], but I am experiencing two issues: - When using the formula '=LOGOVARL("AI1")' to retrieve data from the [product_name] device, the data does not save to disk at the set intervals mentioned in the manual. It only saves when changes are made in the sheet, which means automatic data transfer to my PC does not function as expected. - Periodically, the connection between my PC and the [product_name] drops, as shown in the attached screenshot. Does anyone have suggestions for resolving these problems? Thank you in advance,

Hi, I have been running the [product_name] for a full day without interruption. Suggestions: + Make sure you are using the most recent release of the [product_name] + If the connection fails, try pinging the device's IP address + Check the firmware version of your device + Try directly connecting the device to your PC without any additional hardware like routers in the network + Disable all other network connections on your PC (such as Wi-Fi or additional ethernet ports) + Turn off your firewall temporarily and test again + Review what other programs are active on your PC and disable them for testing + Temporarily deactivate your antivirus software for testing Best of luck.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing inconsistent connection stability and missing automatic data saving features with [product_name] when used with Excel. Connection drops between the PC and device, along with the absence of periodic disk saving as described in documentation, are causing inconvenience. At the same time, some users have managed to operate the tool stably, suggesting that certain environmental settings may influence performance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate smooth, automated data transfers from [product_name] to Excel, requiring a stable, continuous connection and reliable periodic disk saving per manual instructions.
